description: Defines a RecyclerView Adapter 'PosterAdapter' for displaying a list of 'PosterItem' objects as a horizontal row of portrait cards in an Android app.

classes.name: PosterAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter that handles binding PosterItem data to views for display in a horizontal list.

classes.name: PosterViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for the poster item, holds references to the view components.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a PosterViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds PosterItem data to the item view, loads the poster image, and sets click listener.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the adapter.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with new PosterItems and refreshes the view.
